pr_body:
It is not intended that normal execution has a null ApplicationName, so don't make callers need to check for null. When an ApplicationName is not available, it is set to string.Empty.

Fix #68512

issue_context.title: [API Proposal]: Make IHostEnvironment.ApplicationName non-nullable
comments: I couldn't figure out the best area label to add to this issue. If you have write-permissions please help me learn by adding exactly one [area label](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/master/docs/area-owners.md).

> we just pick a default ApplicationName when Assembly.GetEntryAssembly() returns null.

Do you have a proposal for what it should be? `string.Empty`, `"Application"`, ?

I like `string.Empty` or maybe `"<Unkown>"`.

I don't expect this to come up much outside of certain testing and tooling scenarios since `Assembly.GetEntryAssembly()` is usually non-null. I don't think we should use a nice name like `"Application"` which would be a valid default when an entry assembly is found. I'd rather make it obvious that a good default couldn't be found.
I think I like `“<Unknown>”.` That would be a good default when we can’t default anything else.

Went over this with @tarekgh and @eerhardt and for this one we could skip api review because we just annotated this in the past few weeks. 

Compared to 6.0, we went from having no nullable to now having nullable annotated as being not nullable.

The observable change in behavior: on an app we could get null application name but now you'd get default value.

FYI: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.reflection.assembly.getentryassembly?view=net-6.0#:~:text=The%20GetEntryAssembly%20method%20can%20return%20null%20when%20a,was%20unmanaged%20code%20rather%20than%20a%20managed%20assembly.

I ended up needing to go with `string.Empty` because of the following:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/9a0b8f339ddb5cd6d4f7e8c333afc9a74dc545e5/src/libraries/Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting/src/HostingHostBuilderExtensions.cs#L232-L239

When ApplicationName is `<Unknown>` this code throws trying to load an assembly named `<Unknown>`.

review_comments:
Nit: Should we also update `EnvironmentName` to initially be set to "Production" for consistency in how we implement the non-nullable default value?

Or update the assignment of this to be `ApplicationName = Assembly.GetEntryAssembly()?.GetName().Name ?? string.Empty` for consistency the other way?
I don't really like having "policy" here... so instead to be consistent I changed all the non-nullable `string`s in this class to default to `string.Empty`.
